title: Framework where every UI piece is swappable
plain: A cross-platform app framework where colours, styles, layouts, menus, toolbars, dialogs, buttons, sliders, containers and user roles are each a swappable piece, with a demo showing three versions of each.
sources: chat:React UI framework with hot swap demo (Oct 15)

title: Quick porting between Android, web and Python
plain: One framework with several ports (Android, React/Next/TypeScript, Python later) and easy switching between third-party UI libraries.

title: Demo published online
plain: Publish the built demo at xaf.amberxai.com on the VPS, later moved to axf.amberxai.com.
sources: chat:React UI framework with hot swap demo

plain: Rename the framework from 'Frame' to 'AmberX AXF' everywhere, to match the repo.
sources: chat:React UI framework with hot swap demo
git:Rename framework from Frame to AmberX AXF

title: Android port built with the first Android app
plain: Build the Android side of the framework (kernel, engines, templates, starter pieces) alongside the first Android app, with placeholders for future ports.

title: Switch between third-party UI kits
plain: Let apps swap between UI kits (Material 3, unstyled and imported ones) without rewriting screens.
sources: git:lib-browser installable library, install wizard, UI-library import/port engine

title: Floating windows, tab groups and docking
plain: A window system with tab groups, floating windows, split view, minimise corners and drag and drop, on Android and web.

title: Settings, logging and account libraries
plain: Settings and logging libraries for every app, plus placeholder libraries for admin, accounts, profile and billing.

title: AXF Dev Console app
plain: The first app is a framework development console that tracks what's built, picks libraries to build via demo apps, has a feature list with suggestion dialogs and a modules & packages tab.

title: Console as React/TypeScript + Python web app
plain: The console is a React/TypeScript web app with a Python API at console.amberxai.com; the Android console stays as a showcase.

title: Boilerplate manager with live preview
plain: Dozens of categorised boilerplates, a feature checklist that assembles one with a live preview, and import of third-party boilerplates to port.

title: Android console showcase
plain: The Android console with tracker, feature catalog, library picker, modules and element explorer, built in the demo style.
quote: Build it using the demo style

title: Next.js app template
plain: Keep the console on Vite + React and add a separate Next.js template for Next.js apps.

title: Templates to build new libraries
plain: Build, port and compile new libraries from templates across Android, web and Python.
sources: git:Library templates: build, port and compile new libraries from 8 templates

title: Protocol-neutral connections between apps
plain: Let apps talk to each other through pluggable protocols, closed by default, never exceeding the local user's rights.

title: Plugins and libraries follow the theme
plain: Make every plugin and library screen use only theme values so a theme change restyles everything.
sources: git:Make plugin and library UIs conform to the theme engines

title: Themed transparency levels
plain: Add transparency settings to the style themes so see-through colours follow the theme, on both ports.

title: Sizes follow the style theme
plain: Turn about 150 fixed sizes into theme values so spacing and sizes change with the style theme.
sources: git:Make the console's sizes follow the style theme

title: Server control panel
plain: A server control panel with dev servers, command links, APK downloads and an embedded VPS terminal.

title: Plan section with every feature
plain: A Plan section listing every framework feature (448+) with status, ports and a suggested model per feature.

title: Build queue and MCP server
plain: A drag-and-drop build queue in dependency order, plus an MCP server so Claude can read and drive the plan and queue remotely.

title: axHub control plugin with approval PIN
plain: The interface to control axHub is a Dev Console plugin, and approving calls there needs a PIN only Brett knows.
note: approvals moved to the hub's own pages; plugin not found

title: Connector hub on the VPS
plain: A hub on the VPS that links every app, MCP server, API, device and service to Claude Code, routing between them, with a config interface for credentials and addresses.

title: Move demo to axf.amberxai.com
plain: Move the demo from xaf to axf.amberxai.com and delete the old subdomain.

title: React/TypeScript port defined by the console
plain: The first React/TypeScript app (the Dev Console) sets the web port's naming and structure, contributes one template and stays compatible with the shared engines for Android.

title: Console plugin system
plain: Make the console plugin-capable first: manifest-based plugins with their own server routes, on/off switches, broken-plugin isolation.

title: Settings library with Plugins tab
plain: A reusable settings library (Appearance, Account, Connections, Plugins, About) any library or plugin can extend.

title: MCP proxy and admin API
plain: Hub step 3 (MCP proxy with vault credentials) and step 4 (admin API with PIN-gated approvals).

title: Container picker when launching Claude
plain: Typing 'claude' on the VPS asks which container to work in, with numbered choices, a lock-to-one-container option and a status line.

title: Choose Claude plan or API key at launch
plain: The VPS launcher asks whether Claude Code uses the plan login or an API key.

title: Button groups always inside a named parent
plain: Every group of buttons sits in a named toolbar or menu, and any loose element is its own asset, for hot-swapping and a future designer.
note: AssetToolbar component built; full rule is framework-named-assets

title: Theme manager with token tree
plain: Roll colour, style and layout themes with a tree of every token, locks and presets; manages themes for whatever app hosts it.

title: Plugin add-ons and 20 colour themes
plain: All plugins support add-ons (each built for one plugin); a 20-theme add-on (10 dark, 10 light) for the theme designer.

title: Every UI element is a named asset
plain: Every button, slider, toolbar or menu becomes its own named, swappable piece with namespaced ids, so drag-and-drop designers can rebind them.

title: Ten templates per asset type
plain: At least ten editable templates for every asset type the designer covers, plus a default for each.

title: Pending builds list in the console
plain: A console view of builds waiting on Fable, with dates and sorting (mirrors the claude.ai Pending Builds page).

title: No-code Asset Designer plugin
plain: No-code editors for nav menus, drawers, app and context menus, toolbars, layouts, style packs and colour themes, each checked before save.

title: Asset Browser plugin
plain: Browse, preview, import, export and hot-swap assets across apps built on AmberX.

title: MCP client in the console
plain: Connect the console to other MCP servers; rebuilt on the cross-port MCP client library on Fable.

title: Reset the console token
plain: A token reset button under the stored token in the server panel and console settings.

title: Live framework data read from the hub
plain: Keep the pending list, plan, build queue, catalog status and tracker on the VPS hub instead of the repo.

title: Build switches and collapsible groups
plain: Every build takes on/off switches; the first one makes every titled section collapsible with a small corner icon (off for new builds, on for existing files).
quote: every UI build takes -- switches for options

title: Every project has a checked manifest
plain: Every AmberX project has a manifest naming it, its repo and its shared data; nothing loads or builds without a valid one; rules live in a Standards section.

title: Standards section for project rules
plain: A console section (Standards) managing the project manifest rules.

title: Plan search matches every feature
plain: Make Plan search match titles across all features so he can search 'pilotx' directly.

title: Remove PilotX, ShipX, ActiveX references
plain: PilotX, ShipX and ActiveX have nothing to do with AmberX; remove every manifest, folder and note about them.

title: Stop context menu opening while scrolling
plain: On the phone the context menu kept opening while scrolling; fix the long-press timing.

title: Typed layout regions for chrome
plain: Toolbars, navigation and app menus are styled by the style engine and layout regions say what may go in them.
sources: git:Style toolbar/nav-menu/app-menu through the component engine

title: Assistant chats stay alive when browser closes
plain: Every assistant keeps its sessions running on the host so closing the browser or app never ends a chat.

title: Plugin settings live under Settings → Plugins
plain: Plugins never get their own top-level settings tab; each one is a sub-tab of Settings → Plugins.

title: Questions at the start of every session
plain: At the start of every Claude Code session ask location, repo, container, project, memory, model and effort, log them to an archive, installable from Settings.

title: Systems check on every console load
plain: Check GitHub, Anthropic, Hostinger, Coolify, axHub and VPS setup whenever the console loads, as a banner with Grid / By service / Guided setup views and Fix all.
sources: git:Systems check on every console load

title: Fix all pauses for manual steps
plain: Fix all stops and asks (Done / Skip / Stop) whenever a step needs Brett.

title: Make any folder a Claude project
plain: One command that turns any folder into a Claude project with a home on GitHub, the VPS or the device, and offers to port non-AmberX apps.

title: Mosses coder agent with approvals
plain: The coder add-on becomes Mosses: persona, container tools behind approval cards, write-mode badge and undo.

title: Locked-down container access
plain: A master switch for reaching other VPS containers through a locked-down proxy with a protected list, audit log and approved changes.

title: Snapshots before every approved change
plain: Snapshots before every approved change, with a diff and one-step restore.

title: Floating terminal tabs
plain: Floating terminal tabs for containers, the console, the VPS host and Claude Code.

title: Describe features in plain English
plain: Describe a feature in plain English; an expert agent drafts plan entries, or build it with Mosses.

title: Claude memory and rules live on axHub
plain: Claude memory, rules and project files live on axHub and sync with each project's _claude folder, conflicts asked each time; deletes need approval.

title: Rules and memory in the repo
plain: Keep all rules, decisions and memory in the AmberX repo so they're active in every Claude Code session on the VPS.

title: Ask for the model before builds
plain: Launcher model picker and a model policy at session start; later replaced by the orchestrator.
sources: git:Ask for the model: launcher picker
note: replaced Oct 27 by the build orchestrator

title: Bring outside apps onto AmberX
plain: An engine that ports a non-AmberX app either by baking the framework in or rebuilding it from a boilerplate, asking each time which way.

title: Any app clones its own install with data
plain: Turn xGallery's new-project wizard into a library so any AmberX app can clone itself, with its current data, into a new project.

title: Every plugin fully installs and uninstalls
plain: Every plugin ships install and uninstall scripts so newer builds install without leftover code; uninstall leaves nothing behind.

title: AI assistant plugin with many providers
plain: Port xGallery's assistant with 18 provider kinds, a setup wizard in its settings and a settings dialog inside the chat; rebuilt on Fable.

title: Agent manager plugin
plain: Agents built from personas, lingo, skills and tools with their own memory, wizards, training from web/repo/MCP, workflows and add-on agents (coder, framework expert, AI expert); rebuilt on Fable.

title: Console search toolbar
plain: Replace the default toolbar with a live search box that searches pages, actions, settings, dialogs and words, and jumps to what's picked.

title: Editor plugins: last save wins, reload on focus
plain: When theme, style, layout or builder plugins save the same value the last save wins, and each reloads current values whenever it opens or regains focus.

title: Plugin Manager with layouts and views
plain: A Plugin Manager linked from the context menu, with several completely different layouts and views, that opens each plugin's screen and settings and details its dependencies; rebuilt cross-port on Fable.

title: Banner, badge and clock pieces
plain: New swappable pieces: a thin banner at the top that holds badges and a clock; rebuilt on Fable with an Android banner.

title: Widgets and console-wide search bar
plain: Make the clock a widget that attaches to banners and toolbars, and add a search-bar widget that searches the whole console.

title: Developer alerts for every app
plain: A framework alerts library any app can install, delivered to the console bell, ntfy and web push, covering CI failures, deploys, systems check, builds, conflicts and crashes.

title: Hide menus, toolbars or navigation
plain: A Hidden choice for each piece of chrome in Appearance and the theme manager, greying out its other options.

title: Plugins listed on Modules & packages
plain: Show every framework plugin on the Modules & packages page as installed, built or planned.

plain: A console wizard that takes a GitHub repo, VPS repo, folder or new AmberX app, picks where it lives and makes it a Claude project with a Claude.ai project kit.

title: Spacing choice: super tight, compact, regular
plain: A three-way spacing switch in Appearance that scales spacing and corners on both ports, keeping tap targets big enough.

title: Console behind axHub's sign-in wall
plain: User accounts live on axHub and the Dev Console sits behind its sign-in wall, with Brett as admin; machines keep using the console token.

title: Only an admin clears What's new
plain: Only an admin can clear the What's new banner, and clearing it clears it for everyone.

title: AI-made badges in the systems check
plain: Mark everything a model made with small icon badges (AI vs not AI).

title: Anyone with a hub account can chat
plain: Anyone with a hub account can use the AI assistant; non-admins get plain chat, more powers set per user on the hub's users page.
quote: 1 by default but other permissions can be set in the user account control panel

title: Claude badge tests AI on every load
plain: Test the AI connection on every console load and show a green 'Powered by Claude' or grey 'AI unavailable' badge.

title: User accounts and sign-in wall on axHub
plain: An authentication system on axHub (admin + more users with roles, wall at the proxy) with the console behind it.

title: Pilot plugin contract on Fable
plain: Rebuild Build Pilot's plugin contract on Fable so it ports cleanly to Android and future stacks.

title: Assistant, agents and assembling agent in Pilot
plain: Port the AI assistant and agent manager into Build Pilot; all app assembly goes through an agent that only uses existing parts or new approved libraries.

title: Plugin catalog on axHub
plain: A catalog of installable plugins on axHub that any app can install from.

plain: Remove Fable rebuilds of web-only plugins (switches, Claude badge, theme manager, feature assistant, terminal, systems check, snapshots, container access).

title: Pop-up switches for every plugin
plain: A pop-up list of every plugin with on/off switches.

title: App tabs across the console
plain: A whole-page tab group of AmberX apps (Console, Pilot, axHub) picked in its settings.

title: VPS shell registered in axHub
plain: Register the VPS shell in axHub as root so Claude runs commands itself: safe read-only checks without approval, everything else approved.

title: Build Pilot, plugin-driven app designer
plain: A separate app (own repo, pilot.amberxai.com) that designs apps from plugins set per stack, Android first; runs on web then Android; builds through the console's engine.

title: Feature manager applies features via agent
plain: A feature manager plugin that picks features and applies them to the app in progress through the agent.

title: Build APK button in Pilot
plain: A Build APK button; APKs compile on GitHub Actions, not the VPS.

plain: Investigate Hostinger stopping the VPS for malware (exposed Ollama), check the host and clean up.

plain: A console banner listing axHub calls waiting for approval, like the other banners.

title: Approvals feed for the console
plain: A read-only approvals feed from axHub for the console banner.

plain: Move the boilerplate manager, new-app wizard and template browser out of the Dev Console into Build Pilot.
